inputs.text: Israel’s parliament began debating a Bill today that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. If passed, it would be a victory for far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, whose religious party introduced the legislation. Opponents call the Bill racist and draconian, and say it is unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants.
